claims.claim: The pinui-binui special majority (rov meyuchas) is a three-part composite: at least two thirds of all apartments in the makbetz, at least three fifths of the apartments in each beit meshutaf (or at least three apartments where the beit meshutaf has only four or five, with more than two owners), and more than half of the common property in each beit meshutaf attached to their apartments. Source: Section 1 of the 2006 law (סעיף 1).

claims.claim: A separate and lower special majority governs the economic-viability question: more than two fifths of the apartments in each beit meshutaf and more than two fifths of the common property. Source: Section 1 of the 2006 law (סעיף 1).

claims.claim: Under the pinui-binui law a kashish is an apartment owner who was 70 years old at the date the first pinui-binui transaction in that building was signed and had lived in that apartment for at least two years at that date. Source: Section 1 of the 2006 law (סעיף 1).

claims.claim: Where the special majority has agreed and the court finds an owner is unreasonably refusing to transfer rights or conditioning consent on unreasonable terms, the court may either hold that owner liable in tort to the consenting owners, or approve the transaction and appoint an advocate or accountant who is not an owner in the complex to contract on the refusing owner's behalf. Source: Section 2 of the 2006 law (סעיף 2).

claims.claim: 'Tochnit ha-chizuk' now means any of three things, not only TAMA 38: TAMA 38 as in force from time to time; a plan prepared under TAMA 38 that allows a permit without approving a further plan; or a plan applying to a building requiring strengthening under section 70a of the Planning and Building Law that conditions realisation on demolition and rebuild or strengthening to the earthquake standard. The last two exclude a plan applying in a pinui-binui complex. Source: Section 1 of the 2008 law (סעיף 1), current consolidated text.

claims.claim: Before the first pinui-binui transaction is signed the developer must hold or take part in a gathering (kinus) of the apartment owners, and not later than TWO WEEKS before that first signature must deliver to ALL apartment owners a mismach ikarei hatzaa setting out, among other things, the principles for determining the temura he proposes, the securities he offers, and details of his professional experience. Source: Section 1a of the 2006 law (סעיף 1א).

(ב) לא יאוחר משבועיים לפני חתימת עסקת פינוי ובינוי ראשונה, ימסור היזם לכל בעלי הדירות בבית המשותף מסמך עיקרי הצעה, שבו יפורטו, בין השאר, העקרונות לקביעת התמורה המוצעת על ידו, הבטוחות שהוא מציע לבעלי הדירות, וכן פרטים על אודות ניסיונו המקצועי. הודעה על חתימת עסקת פינוי ובינוי ראשונה ומסירת מסמכי העסקה 1ב. claims.claim: On the pinui-binui track a majority of the apartment owners, including someone who is not a party to the transaction, may resolve at a general meeting that the contracting owners may cancel, where either the developer has not contracted with at least half the owners within TWO YEARS of the first transaction or with at least three fifths within FOUR YEARS, or a detailed plan was not submitted to the competent planning institution within FOUR YEARS AND SIX MONTHS. Source: Section 1d(a) of the 2006 law (סעיף 1ד).
claims.raw_snippet: תוקפה של עסקת פינוי ובינוי 1ד. claims.claim: The strengthening track has its OWN clocks. Section 5g of the 2008 law applies Section 1d of the pinui-binui law but replaces paragraphs (1) and (2): the developer must contract with at least half the owners within 18 MONTHS of the first transaction under the strengthening plan, and with the rate required under Section 4 of the 2008 law or the majority permitting application to the mefake'ach under Sections 5 or 5a within THREE YEARS; and a building permit application under Section 145(a3) of the Planning and Building Law must be ACCEPTED within THREE YEARS AND SIX MONTHS. Source: Section 5g of the 2008 law (סעיף 5ג).

Source: Section 4 of the 2008 law (סעיף 4).

claims.claim: On the strengthening track, Section 5b of the 2008 law imports the same pre-signature duties: before the first transaction the developer must hold or take part in a kinus AND deliver the mismach ikarei hatzaa to all owners, all as provided in Section 1a of the pinui-binui law. Where a transaction was signed BEFORE the kinus was held or before the offer document was delivered, a majority of the apartment owners may resolve to cancel it so long as 40 percent of the owners have not yet signed; written notice goes to the developer and the contracting owners are not treated as having breached. Source: Section 5b of the 2008 law (סעיף 5ב).
claims.raw_snippet: כינוס בעלי הדירות ומסירת מסמכים בקשר לעסקה 5ב. (א) בסעיף זה, " יזם " – כהגדרתו בחוק התחדשות עירונית (הסכמים לארגון עסקאות), התשע"ז-2017. (ב) לפני חתימה על עסקה ראשונה לפי תכנית החיזוק, יקיים היזם כינוס של בעלי הדירות בבית המשותף או ישתתף בכינוס כאמור וימסור לכל בעלי הדירות בבית המשותף מסמך עיקרי הצעה, והכול כאמור בסעיף 1א לחוק פינוי ובינוי. (ג) נחתמה עסקה ראשונה לפי תכנית החיזוק, ימסור היזם הודעה על כך לכל בעלי הדירות בבית המשותף. (ד) נחתמה עסקה לפי תכנית החיזוק, ימסור היזם לבעל הדירה שעמו נחתמה העסקה את מסמכי העסקה או העתק נאמן למקור שלהם. (ה) נחתמה עסקה לפי תכנית החיזוק לפני שנערך כינוס של בעלי הדירות בבית המשותף או לפני שנמסר מסמך עיקרי הצעה כאמור בסעיף קטן (ב), רשאים רוב בעלי הדירות בבית המשותף, להחליט על ביטולה, כל עוד לא חתמו על העסקה 40% מבעלי הדירות בבית המשותף; הוחלט על ביטול העסקה כאמור, תימסר על כך הודעה ליזם בכתב, ולא יראו את בעלי הדירות שהתקשרו בעסקה כמי שהפרו את ההתקשרות עם היזם. (ו) על כינוס, מסמך עיקרי הצעה והודעה על חתימת עסקה ראשונה לפי הוראות סעיף זה, יחולו ההוראות לפי סעיף 1ב(ג) לחוק פינוי ובינוי, בשינויים המחויבים.

claims.claim: The pinui-binui track carries the same procedural-defect cancellation at Section 1c: where a transaction was signed before the kinus was held or before the mismach ikarei hatzaa was delivered under Section 1a, a majority of the apartment owners may resolve to cancel the transactions so long as 40 percent of the owners have not signed such transactions; written notice goes to the developer and the contracting owners are not treated as having breached. Source: Section 1c of the 2006 law (סעיף 1ג).

claims.claim: The Memuneh may determine that a pinui-binui transaction is VOID where an owner signed in circumstances of hachtama pog'anit, namely: signing in a language he does not understand without the developer explaining the main terms in a language he understands; the developer exploiting the owner's medical, mental or intellectual disability where the developer knew or should have known of it; the developer creating a misleading impression that he represents a public authority; or the developer giving the owner misleading information, INCLUDING misleading information about how many owners had agreed to the transaction by the signing date, or about the terms agreed with other owners. Source: Section 5b of the 2006 law (סעיף 5ב).
claims.raw_snippet: פנייה לממונה לעניין פניות דיירים בהתחדשות עירונית 5ב. claims.claim: Section 6 of the 2006 law requires anyone who acts on a developer's behalf, who receives or will receive consideration from the developer or the builder, or whose fee depends on a pinui-binui transaction taking place, to state that clearly in the FIRST approach to the apartment owners, before an engagement agreement is signed, and in the text of that agreement. Such a person must also report on his own initiative any non-negligible difference in the temura one owner will receive compared with others in the complex. Breach of either duty is a ground for an owner to WITHDRAW consent already given to a pinui-binui transaction, even if he signed a binding engagement agreement. Source: Section 6 of the 2006 law (סעיף 6).

claims.claim: The 2025 regulations made under Section 1d(e) set a schedule of the payment due to the developer per apartment whose transaction was cancelled. On the pinui-binui track: no payment where the developer contracted with the owner of only one apartment, or failed to reach a fifth of the apartments in a building of at most 34 apartments (or 7 apartments in a larger one); 5,000 NIS where he did not reach at least half; 7,000 NIS where he did not reach three fifths, and 7,000 NIS at the two-thirds limb; 10,000 NIS where no detailed plan was submitted. On the strengthening track the figures are 500 NIS at the half limb, 700 NIS at the section 4 rate or mefake'ach-majority limb, and 1,800 NIS where the building permit application was not accepted.
